scope: Read complete private upload/readback controller. No execution, API request, capacity/process scan, private repository change, or retirement by reviewer.
observedGuards: Exact repository full name, numeric ID 1474927804, private=true, owner login and not-archived checks before creation/upload and after readback.
Exact original archive 1463489048 bytes / SHA256 6e5202a79e92edd6d03c0c00af50a94633539817fb34bc3a203c7340239d71e7, regular single-link leaf and device/inode/mtime/ctime equality around reads.
Exact previously verified archive receipt SHA50987d6a7daa36458322f755068f6730609ad470309ab2fa6cd4e96fdcf0720e and every_source_file_maps_to_verified_member=true.

Metadata tar gathers all regular source-directory siblings existing in that snapshot, records source identity/size/SHA and checks each after packing; manifest binds metadata archive and archive payload.

Draft release only; no retry or clobber. Exact remote asset name set and sizes, optional provider digest, then complete authenticated stream SHA and byte count for each archive/metadata/manifest asset.
Final success rechecks original archive identity/SHA and private repository. Local artifact remains; no removal operation is implemented.

findings.location: Both Popen calls precede fallible PROCESS ledger/setup operations outside their try/cleanup region.
findings.consequence: A ledger write or readback selector/setup exception can bypass stop_owned and leave that owned transfer process running. This does not negate an actually completed whole-byte success receipt, but failed attempts require explicit owned-process closure before retirement.
findings.minimumCorrectionForFutureExecution: Enter try/finally immediately after successful Popen; record the owned child before other fallible setup, guarantee closure on setup/ledger failure, and retain the original exact-child signal fence. Do not stop the already running authorized job merely from this source finding.

findings.consequence: Its receipt alone is not an unlink implementation or proof of restoration-pointer durability/no active use.
findings.minimumCorrectionForRetirement: Use the exact one-leaf contract in this review and obtain the root-reviewed separate retirement controller/receipt.

retirementContract.requiredRemoteProof: Consume the actual terminal whole-byte VERIFIED_PRIVATE_PRESERVATION receipt; pin exact numeric release and three asset IDs, names, byte counts and SHA256. Require authenticated full-stream success for original archive, metadata tar and manifest. Cross-join manifest to receipt and metadata tar members to the manifest before unlink. A partial upload or provider digest alone is insufficient.
retirementContract.requiredRestorationPointer: Before unlink, durably save and independently read back a fixed restoration pointer and script, with hashes, outside the retiring leaf and in the Git-backed/private preservation evidence. The script must recheck private repo numeric identity, download the exact pinned asset IDs without exposing credentials, verify all three complete payload sizes/SHA and metadata members, then recreate only the intended artifact with exclusive creation. Record the original leaf mode/owner/timestamps in the pointer; no extraction into arbitrary source roots.
retirementContract.requiredFreshSourceFence: Pin/open the exact existing parent directory with O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW, require its known dev/inode, then open the single basename with O_NOFOLLOW relative to that fd. Require regular file, link count1, exact receipt device/inode/size/mtime/ctime and full SHA. Re-fstat the same open descriptor after hashing; before unlink require parent-fd leaf lookup still matches. Keep all other metadata siblings and parent identity unchanged.
retirementContract.requiredNoUse: Require original uploader/readback job terminal and no active holder of the exact leaf dev/inode/path, including open/mapped references; inspection failures are refusal. Recheck immediately before unlink. Do not signal any process as part of this controller. The archive source remains until this proof is current.
retirementContract.requiredPredeleteDurability: Fsync a bounded PREDELETE receipt and its containing directory outside the leaf; independently read back/hash acknowledge the exact receipt before the authorized unlink. Bind actual remote proof, restoration pointer/script hashes, source identity and no-use evidence. Keep raw failures and an idempotent partial/terminal outcome.
retirementContract.allowedMutation: One os.unlink of the fixed basename using the pinned parent dirfd after final guards, followed by parent fsync. No recursion, rmtree, globs, follows, parent removal, other artifact deletion, remote asset/repository change or SDK/native run.
retirementContract.postcondition: Confirm only that leaf is absent, parent and all protected metadata siblings retain their identities/content, every restoration asset/receipt remains referenced, and write a durable terminal result. Report actual free before/after as concurrent observations, not guaranteed reclaimed allocation.
retirementContract.abort: Any changed source/archive/metadata/remote identity, missing or partial readback, failed durability acknowledgement, active/unknown use, path mismatch or missing original receipt aborts unchanged.

result: SOURCE_REVIEW_ONLY; upload success and future retirement remain contingent on actual runtime receipts; no SDK/native/production/TestFlight acceptance.
